title: US takes down alleged Chinese hacking tools used against Federal Reserve, DOJ and Senate
content_md: Jonathan Greig reports; Chinese government hackers used tools known as “QScan” and “QTRouter” to breach multiple federal agencies since 2018, the Department of Justice said in announcing the takedown of the platforms on Wednesday.
